summary: Two brothers (one in his 20s, one in his 30s) overdue from the Aspen-to-Crested Butte hike over West Maroon Pass. Dropped off at the Maroon Lake Trailhead Wednesday morning and expected in Crested Butte by 1 p.m.; parents reported them to 911 about 9:45 p.m. A measured response and overnight reassessment followed; on Friday morning 8 MRA volunteers and 6 CBSAR members deployed at 8:15 a.m. and found the brothers unhurt on the Gunnison County side of West Maroon Pass at about 9:20 a.m.; all assets out by 10 a.m.
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen (8 volunteers); Crested Butte Search and Rescue (6 members); Pitkin County Sheriff dispatch
notes: Date approximate: hike began 2021-09-01, reassessment 2021-09-02, SAR deployment and find Friday morning 2021-09-03 per the scraper site's press-release-derived account; its companion article garbles the day as "Thursday". Resolves the run-489 pending lead; zero corroborating primary coverage surfaced.
